messages:
ashley: FYI found a base64 SA blob in staging app logs from last night's partner webhook deploy. looks like an unmasked service-account JSON got logged.

jordan: can you paste the minimal masked snippet so we can grep?

ashley: masked snippet: `POST /webhook body={..."config":"eyJhb..."}` seen in cloud logging (projects/redwood-staging/logs/app_logs).

lenora: are those keys still valid?

ashley: yes, created last month. I already blocked the webhook and removed the staging SA's IAM bindings.

mike: good. suggested remediation: 1) hunt & delete plaintext in Vault/KV and k8s volumes, 2) rotate the GCP SA key, 3) rewrap any KMS ciphertexts referencing old key, 4) update sealed secrets / CI, 5) enable extended audit export.

samir: do we have entries in Vault transit or plain kv?

ashley: both. two plaintext KV v2 entries under secret/data/partner/webhooks plus some transit-wrapped blobs.

lenora: owners: ashley+jordan for hunt/expunge; mike for SA rotation & backup rewrap; samir for rewrap audit; jordan for CI swap to Vault; lenora for lease revocation + RBAC lock. sec-bot/oncall to bump audit retention.

ashley: I'll run a grep across logs and pod volumes and post affected paths.

jordan: mike, can you create a new least-priv SA and replace key, then share sealed path?

mike: creating new SA webhook-staging-rot-2026 with minimal scopes. command: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/webhook-rot.json --iam-account=webhook@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. will disable old key then rewrap backups.

samir: rewrap approach: decrypt old -> encrypt with new KMS key or use Vault transit rewrap. will record old->new mapping.

oncall: audit: enabling export to secure bucket with object versioning and 90d retention. also adding a log alert for base64 SA pattern.

lenora: RBAC: temporarily grant write to path secret/data/partner/* only to `webhook-rotator` role during rotation. policy will be applied in staging namespace and revoked after.

ashley: found 3 k8s pod volume files and two vault kv entries. uploading list to the incident ticket.

sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-721. Severity S2. Assigned eng-security.

mike: disabled old key; new key live; starting backup rewrap job (ETA ~6h).

samir: rewrap 18/23 backups done, finishing remainder. mapping doc in shared drive.

jordan: CI changes: switched GH Actions to fetch ephemeral secrets from Vault transit; canary rollout at 10% pods, no errors so far.

ashley: deleted plaintext entries from Vault and removed leaked files from pods. verified no more occurrences in logs. reopened webhook briefly for validation then closed.

lenora: RBAC will be returned to normal after 30m verification. postmortem owners: lenora(writeup), ashley(remediation verification), mike(key hygiene), jordan(ci migration), samir(rewrap audit). target publish in 7 days.

sec-bot: INC-2026-721 status: mitigated.

ashley: follow-up: add pre-commit check to repo to reject commits containing SA-like base64 patterns and runtime scrubbing in webhook handler. filing a tech-debt ticket.

lenora: thanks everyone. closing coordinating thread. :thumbsup:
